cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Should those really be tied? I see `tie_word_embeddings` to be False by default in the text config, so just want to make sure.
Note that the text config will not control it, since it is part of the main model, `LightOnOcrConfig` is the one controlling it. 
If it should not be tied, let's remove this mapping
